public_rationale: The factual scope criticism is supported. AlphaGeometry2's own report identifies geometry problems its language cannot express, including inequalities and variable numbers of points; it also documents other coverage gaps. These limitations are inconsistent with general mastery. The headline criticism needs qualification: Nature's podcast appeared in January 2024, concerned the original AlphaGeometry, and discussed a narrower Olympiad achievement. This outcome supports the capability claim, not an assertion that Nature explicitly promised comprehensive mastery.
limitations: Support depends on reading figured out geometry as general mastery.
The report's substantial Olympiad achievements can coexist with the documented coverage gaps.
The Nature podcast is about another system and period, so it is context only.
